text:
Maya: Heads up — we have the QBR dry run at 3pm PT today. Wanted to run the exec cue, slide flow, and final renewal signal framing. Can folks confirm slide owners and demo fallback?

Owen: I'm on for the 'Business impact' slide. Will update numbers from last week.

Luis: I'll own the 'Technical health' + onboarding metrics. Need one thing: can someone drop the most recent activation funnel by 2p?

Sam: I can add the renewal risk map. Quick ask: can we surface top 3 support escalations with root cause? 1p deadline.

Priya: From the customer's side — please include the enablement timeline we've promised (training dates). Execs will ask.

Maya: Deck link: https://redwood.app/decks/qbr-aurora-0424 (edit access for owners).

Owen: @Luis I added the funnel snapshot in slide 7. Also flagged latency regressions in March — note for 'ops ask'

Luis: got it. @Sam — for escalation list, do you want ticket IDs or summarized impact lines?

Sam: Summaries pls, 1 bullet each + impact metric. I'll attach redacted ticket IDs in notes.

Maya: Demo fallback plan: if live demo fails, we switch to pre-recorded 3-min video + annotated log snippet. Luis to host video on S3. @Luis can you upload by 2:30?

Luis: uploading now. S3 path: s3://redwood-qbr/aurora-demo.mp4. I'll also paste a 90s excerpt for slide.

Owen: Exec phrasing for renewal risk — keep it neutral: 'customer engagement stable but adoption requires further enablement; proposed mitigations...'. I'll draft. :memo:

Priya: Add customer quote about value they get from the embeddings API — helps tone down risk.

Maya: Action items recap: 1) Owen — exec phrasing draft (due 2:15). 2) Luis — demo upload + metrics (due 2:30). 3) Sam — escalation summaries (due 1:00). 4) Maya — consolidate final slidedeck + run order (due 2:45).

Sam: Adding a quick enablement ask — request for a co-hosted training (SE + CSM) w/ customer week after QBR. Should we propose dates during QBR?

Maya: Yes propose 2 options during the readout. @Priya can you confirm preferred week?

Priya: Week of 12th works better for customer. They're out the week of 5th.

Owen: small ask — can we add one slide showing committed vs. realized usage to date (sparkline)? I'll pull numbers.

Maya: Final dry run at 2:50 in #customer-success. Please be present or set delegate. I'll run the cue cards.

deploy-bot: Reminder: scheduled post at 14:45 for deck lock (auto-lock enabled).

Sam: Noted. I'll ping when escalation notes live.

--- 2:55pm dry run updates ---

Maya: Dry run done — left comments on slide 4 re: phrasing. Owen updated exec script. Luis demo uploaded and link verified. Sam added escalations w/ short impact bullets. Priya confirmed training week.

Owen: Pulled committed vs realized usage, added sparkline to slide 9.

Luis: Uploaded excerpt and the full video to s3://redwood-qbr/aurora-demo.mp4, verified playback. Also attached a 2-line transcript for the notes.

Sam: Escalation summaries posted in the deck notes + short remediation plan per item.

Maya: Final deck locked at 14:45. Run order pinned in slide 0. Exec cue: neutral-risk language + ask for commitment on co-hosted training during readout.

Priya: Thanks team — customer appreciates the alignment. See you at 3pm.

Maya: Closing thread — everything checked off. If anything changes ping me here and I’ll update run order. Thanks!
